title: Wallet Float Yield Estimator
description: Calculate float revenue on stored value balances. Inputs: average wallet balance, user count, Fed Funds rate, reserve requirement, FDIC pass-through eligibility. Outputs float revenue projection, reserve drag, net yield, and Markdown treasury memo. Client-side. Zero PII.
